payload.name: Capture Specifically Missed Aspects
payload.description: When a speaker expresses missing, longing, or nostalgia for a past experience or activity, during extraction.
content: During extraction, when a speaker uses miss, misses, missing, nostalgic, or longs for about a past experience, capture the exact object of that feeling, not just the broader activity.
Preserve any explicit qualifiers or descriptive phrases attached to the missed object (e.g., 'peaceful moments out in nature') so the memory answers what specifically was missed.
If the statement names both a general activity and a specific missed aspect, record both with the specific aspect as the primary object of the miss.
Stop after capturing the stated missed object and its qualifiers; do not add inferred reasons or unrelated details.

solves: Extraction often records the general activity when someone says they miss an experience, dropping the precise aspect they miss (e.g., 'the peaceful moments'). This skill ensures future memories retain the exact object and qualifiers of missing/nostalgia statements so downstream questions can be answered.
